prompt: The Brihadeeswarar Temple was built by an Indian emperor. The emperor’s only sister‘s husband is a king of another Dynasty. Name the Dynasty and state how many known kings ruled within that Dynasty.
answer:
The emperor was **Rajaraja Chola I**, builder of the Brihadeeswarar Temple. His only sister, **Kundavai**, married **Vimaladitya**, a ruler of the **Eastern Chalukya (Chalukyas of Vengi) dynasty**.

The Eastern Chalukya dynasty is generally recorded as having **27 known rulers**.
